description:
10.0+a Ha Yeon-hee, who has been hiding her eyesight, ends up slapping someone in the face while trying to catch a mosquito. But that person is our company's youngest and the idol of the female employees! CEO Yoo Jeong-an?!! Jeong-an tries to catch the spy in the company using Yeon-hee's eyesight... . Yeon-hee catches a spy and captures the CEO's heart, and the prickly CEO Jeong-an's eye-cleansing romance.
